verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is published under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a hosted email service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Gmail's source being published or openly licensed. Its public APIs, IMAP/SMTP support and add-ons are integration surfaces, not source access.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
